subject: App working locally, erroring in deployment

messages.author: aca44eb0740bad32
messages.subject: App working locally, erroring in deployment
parts:
Howdy!

I'm trying to help out a colleague from the epidemiology world deploy some Shiny apps he has put together.

Here is the code for the app:
https://github.com/daguar/shinyappsio-epi-test

I am able to run it locally in RStudio, but when I deploy I receive the following error:

ERROR: object 'lhjlist' not found

(Here's my deploy: https://daguar.shinyapps.io/shinyapps-test4/ )

I'm not super familiar with R scoping (I'm a software dev guy more than an R guy) so I'm guessing it might have something to do with loading the data file, but would appreciate any help (and happy to contribute back documentation for others).

Thanks!
Dave

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App working locally, erroring in deployment
parts: Hi there, lines 1-40 in server.R should be pulled out of that file and put in a separate file called global.R. This is because server.R isn't guaranteed to be executed before ui.R, but global.R is guaranteed to run before either.
